verdicts.reason: A has fallen apart: the player card is gone, 'MARKETING' sits directly on top of the glasses photo, the slider knobs float over the headline as grey blobs, the timestamps and rewind/forward controls are scattered, empty cream boxes sit at the bottom and the avatar is stranded in a corner. It is unusable. B keeps the card on the photo and stays recognisable, but the avatar hangs off the card's left edge and overlaps the title pill, 'By Amy Jean' is clipped behind the avatar, '01:58' has jumped next to '00:00', the headline is pushed right and doesn't line up with the left-aligned 'WEEKLY REVIEW', and the bottom of the card is cramped. B is the less bad of the two but still broken.
